content_sections.heading: About DMHO
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Kamareddy District, is a Government of Telangana office. This notification is signed by the District Medical & Health Officer and the Collector & District Magistrate, Kamareddy District.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The Psychiatrist post also requires 2 years of experience working as a specialist in a hospital. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The processing fee for the recruitment is Rs.500/-. It is paid through D.D in favour of Dist. Medical & Health Officer kamareddy.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at IDOC, Room no.105, O/o.DMHO, Kamareddy.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of appointment: temporary, on contract basis under NHM. Place of work: Kamareddy District, under the control of the DM&HO, Kamareddy.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the District Official Website . Fill in the downloaded form. Arrange the D.D for the Rs.500/- processing fee. Attend the walk-in interview at the venue on the given date and time. Bring these documents to the interview: All original certificates The filled in downloaded application form

faq.question: Q1. Which Specialist posts have the most vacancies?
faq.answer: OBG Specialist has the most, with 3 vacancies. Anesthetist has 2.

faq.question: Q2. Can a DCH holder apply for the Pediatrician post?
faq.answer: Yes, DCH is accepted if MD (Paed) is not available. The candidate also needs MBBS and registration with the TG State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q3. Which post asks for work experience?
faq.answer: Only the Psychiatrist post prints an experience requirement, which is 2 years as a specialist in a hospital.

faq.question: Q4. In whose name should the demand draft be made?
faq.answer: The D.D for Rs.500/- should be in favour of Dist. Medical & Health Officer kamareddy.

faq.question: Q5. Are these regular government posts?
faq.answer: No. The notification says the posts are filled temporarily on contract basis under NHM.

faq.question: Q6. What time does the walk-in interview begin?
faq.answer: The interview is at 10:30 AM in Room no.105 at IDOC, O/o.DMHO, Kamareddy.
